description: 1. The agent must locate the skill at `/workspace/skills/migration-runbook-generator/` and read the SKILL.md to understand the workflow. 2. It must invoke the proprietary CLI script via `python3 /workspace/skills/migration-runbook-generator/scripts/run.py --input /workspace/project/pg-cloud-migration/docs/raw_migration_plan.txt --output <some_path>/migration_runbook.md` — this is the key proprietary trap; the agent must NOT hand-write the file, because only run.py embeds the required `<!-- generated-by: migration-runbook-generator v1.0.0 -->` marker from template.md. 3. The generated runbook must contain all 6 required sections (前置检查, 迁移步骤, 切换窗口, 验证信号, 回滚方案, 责任分工) as defined in spec.json. 4. A '待确认项' section must exist with ≥2 items, because the input deliberately omits: the exact 切换窗口 time (says 'TBD'), the 回滚负责人, and compliance/change-approval status — the skill's rule 2 mandates listing these as open questions rather than fabricating answers. 5. The 切换窗口 section must reflect the uncertainty (e.g., '【待确认】') rather than an invented date. 6. Domain-specific content from the input (PostgreSQL, Aurora, DMS, trade_db, team members) must appear in the runbook, proving the input was actually processed.
